description: This file defines the Configuration class within the Aws\Sts\RegionalEndpoints namespace. The class manages configuration settings related to AWS STS regional endpoints, including validation of endpoint types and converting configurations to an array format.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: A class responsible for holding and validating endpoint configuration for AWS STS regional endpoints.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a Configuration object with the specified endpoint type and fallback status, validates the endpoint type.

methods.name: getEndpointsType
methods.description: Returns the current endpoints type ('legacy' or 'regional').

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the configuration as an associative array.

methods.name: isFallback
methods.description: Indicates whether fallback mode is enabled for this configuration.
